hypothesis: Frozen real-Zebrahub U-Net node features contain morphology and local context that a small symmetric daughter-pair head can use more efficiently than the scratch crop encoder rejected by EXP159.
parent: EXP159 proposal construction and external gate; robust competition parent remains reciprocal scratch registered-Hungarian score 0.6761456762872732.
single_change: Replace the scratch 3D crop encoder with frozen 32-channel node features from the independently trained real-Zebrahub checkpoint; train only a symmetric pair MLP. Proposal K=4, external split, negative sampling and precision/recall gate remain fixed.
training: Twelve epochs, AdamW 3e-4, BCE positive weight 12, exactly 256 external train shards. Validation scores all parents in the independent 64-shard time split with the existing 21-frame gap.
external_gate: Proceed only if proposal recall ceiling is at least 0.90, pair AP is reported, parent precision is at least 0.50 and parent recall is at least 0.20 at one source-selected threshold.
competition_gate: No competition inference unless the external gate passes. Then freeze the selected checkpoint and threshold, require nonnegative source score in both reciprocal directions, no true-division loss, and zero false forks in a direction without true divisions before opening one prospective 24-movie target pass.
reproducibility: The visual backbone is eval-only/no-grad, so its internal pooling has no backward nondeterminism. The trainable pair head uses deterministic linear/layer-normalization operations with CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 and seed 158031.
implementation_tests: 5 passed across proposal construction, external-path guard, parent thresholding, scratch-head symmetry and pretrained-feature-head exact daughter-swap invariance.
resource: One RTX6000 through the common queue; 8 CPU, 32 GiB RAM, 4 GiB disk, 45 minutes; one GPU job for this project.
